text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Osaka Hai. Satono Crown 
finds herself standing before an intensely 
imposing Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black vows to defeat all of her 
rivals and take center stage this year. 
And Satono Crown feels the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone else take center 
stage—!
